name: Single Back - Tight Left Wing Left - 27 Handoff
call: Single Back Tight Left Wing Left 27 Handoff

QB.rule: Open left and hand the ball to the fullback, then carry out the fake away from him. It holds the backside end.

FB.rule: Take the handoff and hit it downhill at our tackle's outside hip. Never bounce it outside.

coaching_points: The only back carries it, so there is nobody behind him to lead. The wing is the lead blocker, and that is why the call puts him on the left.

Run it at the tight end. The X is beside his tackle here and the C gap is a real hole; on the split side the same gap is five yards of grass and this play does not exist. The build rejects it the other way round.
The fullback is alone in the backfield, so he is the whole run game in this formation. Every number here is a 2.
